## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the rules for the Single Endless Survival Phase—including uninterrupted `GameState.PLAYING` upon Boss defeat and `GameState.DEFEAT` only upon `Z >= 9.0` breach—explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §FR-011]

- [x] CHK003 Are the collision, 3D shatter FX, and immediate removal requirements specified when an advancing Boss overlaps an `xN` or `+N` gate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are time-based escalation rules specified for both Soldier waves (interval and burst count) and Boss spawns (interval, HP, speed, and concurrent cap)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]
